breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines M(x) as a variable function M(x) = -P(L-x), which properly represents the linearly varying bending moment along the cantilever span. It does not use a constant peak moment value. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which requires setting up M(x) as a function of position before integrating, rather than using the constant peak value M = PL over the full span.
